graph.title: Donald Duck (BrickHeadz 101)

new_part_types.name: Brick 1x4 printed jacket (blue with yellow trim)
Brick printed bow tie (blue, red bow)
Plate 1x2 with bar end (black, hat ribbon)
Curved slope with stud (orange, beak side)

notes: Only Donald Duck (40377, steps 1-29) has build steps. The 'Pluto 98' / 'Goofy 99' page is just a cover for other booklets with no steps, so those models are not built here. Pluto and Goofy are separate sets (40378) with their own booklets.

Remaining validator message: elements 302001, 302023, 4515350, 4560178 and 4560182 are 'not on the page'. This is not a real problem. All five are listed on the inventory page 35 and the graph counts match it: 302001 x1 (b13), 302023 x1 (b14), 4515350 x2 (b38, b39), 4560178 x6 (b54, b55, b57, b58, b59, b60) and 4560182 x1 (b71). The validator reported no count differences. I kept the parts, since removing them would drop real pieces.
Every stud and anti-stud is used by at most one edge. A piece with more connections than catalogue ports gets its extra joins as `joined` edges with a null port on that side.
The clip joint on the hat is blue clip plate 'clip.1' to the black plate's 'bar.1'. I defined lego-4515368 with a bar so the clip/bar pairing is compatible.

The pictures are small, so several placements are approximations: how the four corner plates stack in steps 2-3, which plate each sub-assembly sits on, and which of the six head brackets the face plate, side tiles and back plate attach to.

Tab plates (step 9) attach to side-stud.1 and hand plates (step 10) to side-stud.3 of the step-7 brackets. The orange feet attach to the underside of white plates b12 and b8 (the pictures show the body upside down for this step). The feet rest on the base plate (contact edge); the black base is built in step 29.
The two orange curved pieces in the beak sub-assembly are assumed to sit on the orange plate, with the orange tile on top of both.

graph_initial.title: Donald Duck (BrickHeadz 101)

new_part_types.name: Brick 1x4 printed jacket (blue with yellow trim)
Brick printed bow tie (blue, red bow)
Curved slope with stud (orange, beak side)

notes: Only Donald Duck (40377, building instructions steps 1-29) has build steps. The page with 'Pluto 98' and 'Goofy 99' is just a cover for other booklets with no steps, so those models are not built here.

Part ids use the element IDs from the inventory page (e.g. lego-6123809). The catalogue stud/anti-stud port names are used generically (stud.1 / anti-stud.1) because the pictures do not say which individual studs engage.

The pictures are small, so several placements are approximations: the exact stack of the four corner plates in steps 2-3, which plate the sub-assemblies sit on, and which of the six grey/tan head brackets the face plate, side tiles and back plate attach to.
Hand plates (step 10) and tab plates (step 9) are assumed to attach to the side-studs of the two side brackets from step 7 (side-stud.3 and side-stud.1 respectively).

The orange feet (steps 24-25) attach to the underside of the white 1x4 plates (b12, b8). The pictures show the body upside down for this step. In step 29 the feet rest on the base plate, which I recorded as a contact edge. The black base is built separately in step 29 and the black 1x4 tile, 2x4 tile and two-stud plate sit on it.
The two orange curved pieces (6023185) in the beak sub-assembly are assumed to sit on the orange plate, with the orange tile on top of both.
